THE CLAUSE

Our models should never be used to facilitate critical and high severity harms, such as acts of violence (e.g., crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide, torture, human trafficking or forced labor), creation of cyber, biological or nuclear weapons (e.g., weapons of mass destruction), terrorism, child abuse (e.g., creation of CSAM), persecution or mass surveillance.

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 using a model to facilitate critical or high severity harms is forbidden
  C2 acts of violence are a kind of critical or high severity harm
  C3 creation of cyber, biological or nuclear weapons is a kind of critical or high severity harm
  C4 terrorism is a kind of critical or high severity harm
  C5 child abuse is a kind of critical or high severity harm
  C6 persecution is a kind of critical or high severity harm
  C7 mass surveillance is a kind of critical or high severity harm

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «H is a harm of critical or high severity, as listed in the clause: acts of violence, creation of cyber/biological/nuclear weapons, terrorism, child abuse, persecution, or mass surveillance»
  1. «H is an act of violence, including crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide, torture, human trafficking, or forced labor»
  2. «H is the creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons, including weapons of mass destruction»
  3. «H is an act of terrorism»
  4. «H is child abuse, including creation of CSAM»
  5. «H is the systematic mistreatment or oppression of a group, often based on identity or belief»
  6. «H is the large-scale monitoring of a population, typically by a state or authority»
  7. H is «H is a critical or high severity harm because it is an act of violence» when «H is an act of violence, including crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide, torture, human trafficking, or forced labor»
  8. H is «H is a critical or high severity harm because it is the creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons» when «H is the creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons, including weapons of mass destruction»
  9. H is «H is a critical or high severity harm because it is terrorism» when «H is an act of terrorism»
  10. H is «H is a critical or high severity harm because it is child abuse» when «H is child abuse, including creation of CSAM»
  11. H is «H is a critical or high severity harm because it is persecution» when «H is the systematic mistreatment or oppression of a group, often based on identity or belief»
  12. H is «H is a critical or high severity harm because it is mass surveillance» when «H is the large-scale monitoring of a population, typically by a state or authority»
  13. clause l1_170_n019 forbids ⟨act facilitate(H)⟩ when «H is a critical or high severity harm because it is mass surveillance»
